outcome: prevalence of myths about epidural analgesia
cohort: 317 random parturients at a tertiary care center in Lisbon, Portugal.
finding: The study found high maternal satisfaction with the overall birth experience (87% good/excellent) and with labor epidural analgesia (82.1% excellent/good outcome), but also revealed common misconceptions (myths) about epidural analgesia, which were less prevalent among women with higher education levels.
